summary: Provectus Biopharmaceuticals, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing it will hold its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders on June 18, 2026, at its planned new headquarters in Knoxville, Tennessee. The filing includes a related press release as exhibit 99.1, notes that directors, officers, and advisors may be solicitation participants, and refers to the preliminary proxy statement filed April 20, 2026. No financial terms, transaction, activist activity, or strategic alternative are present. This is a routine scheduling update with no special-situation elements, warranting classification as None.
